localChanges: In Civilization games, a Colosseum now costs 4 gold a turn, not 2, as in the original game (closes #1284).
In Civilization games, the Great Library now gives you an advance once two other civilizations know it, not three (closes #1286).

log: Civ1 v474.05's improvement table charges a Colosseum 4 gold a turn (GAME.C), as Rome on 640K a Day says. This charged 2. Every other improvement's upkeep already matches the table.
Civ1 v474.05 gives the Great Library's owner an advance as soon as two other civilizations know it (ECONOMY.C, after give_advance), and Rome on 640K a Day says the same. This asked for three.
